command.name: pter
command.description: Run the plan to tasks to execute to review workflow

roles.label:  Planner
roles.handoff: Continue planning from the current PLAN.md state and the user's latest adjustment. Do not implement or change any other repository file.

roles.label:  Task writer
roles.handoff: Re-read PLAN.md and TASKS.md, then continue task writing from the current artifacts. Do not change PLAN.md or implement anything.

roles.label:  Executor
roles.handoff: Re-read PLAN.md, TASKS.md, the base ref, and REVIEW.md when present. Continue from the first unchecked task or named review finding. Keep TASKS.md accurate and never commit or stage.

roles.label:  Reviewer
roles.handoff: Perform an independent review from the current PLAN.md, TASKS.md, implementation, and base ref. Use the previous REVIEW.md only as optional context and edit nothing except REVIEW.md.
